activities.activity: Tower crane final dismantle and removal
prerequisites: All heavy roof plant lifts completed
Auxiliary mobile crane positioned and lift plan approved
activities.procedure_required: Engineered top-down dismantle per crane manufacturer sequence with exclusion zone management, component tagging, and make-good of tie and base locations
activities.safety_hold_point: Hold before each section lowering — confirm exclusion zone clear and wind below limit; hold before removing final tie to verify crane stability state
activities.acceptance_criteria: Crane fully removed without incident; roof and core make-good inspected and waterproofed; dismantle records filed

activities.procedure_required: Review of installer QA records, leak detection reports, and visual inspection of accessible areas; compile warranty registration dossier
activities.safety_hold_point: Confined space entry permits for basement inspection areas with atmospheric testing
activities.acceptance_criteria: Zero active ingress observed; documentation complete; manufacturer warranty registered and issued to client

prerequisites: Core walls at handover level cured to design strength
activities.procedure_required: Dimensional and plumb survey of core relative to floor grids, verification of bearing surfaces, embedment and sleeve positions against coordinated drawings
activities.safety_hold_point: Edge protection verified complete before inspection teams access slab perimeter
activities.acceptance_criteria: Tolerances within specification; all embeds match MEP coordinated positions; survey report signed by engineer

activities.activity: Post-tensioning stress and grout compliance verification
activities.procedure_required: Audit of elongation records against calculations for sampled tendons per floor, grout cube results review, vent return observations, anchorage seating checks
activities.safety_hold_point: Exclusion zone behind anchorage during stressing; no personnel in line of strand release path
activities.acceptance_criteria: Sampled elongations within +/-7%; grout cubes pass; no unexplained anomalies; compliance dossier complete per floor

prerequisites: Test zone fully installed and sealed internally
activities.procedure_required: Chambered air permeability test to specified pressure differentials followed by water spray test per ASTM/AAMA-equivalent method with interior observation
activities.safety_hold_point: Exterior access suspended beneath test zone during pressurisation; chamber structural attachment verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Air leakage and water penetration within specified limits; any failure diagnosed, rectified, and retested successfully

prerequisites: All panel and insulation consignments delivered
activities.procedure_required: Systematic review of fire classification certificates against specification for every installed batch; audit of cavity barrier photographic records per floor; golden-thread compilation
activities.safety_hold_point: No zone declared complete until evidence review closes without non-conformance
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% batch traceability to compliant certificates; barrier continuity records complete; dossier accepted by building control reviewer

activities.procedure_required: End-to-end pressure/continuity testing of each riser (hydraulic, electrical busbar, ventilation) verifying no cross-connection losses or discontinuities across all levels
activities.safety_hold_point: Electrical riser energisation only after insulation resistance verification and permit-to-energise sign-off
activities.acceptance_criteria: Each riser holds test parameters end-to-end; records per riser signed by MEP Coordinator

activities.activity: Elevator/escalator commissioning including safe-mode wet test
activities.procedure_required: OEM commissioning: dynamic runs at contract speed, levelling, door operations, safety circuits, firefighter recall and evacuation modes, escalator safety device chain, ride quality measurement
activities.safety_hold_point: Shaft entry under controlled access only; hoistway doors locked out during rope/counterweight work; no ride tests with unprotected openings
activities.acceptance_criteria: All safety tests pass including firefighter mode witnessed; ride quality within specification; handover files complete per unit

activities.activity: Fire alarm cause and effect test
prerequisites: Interfaces to smoke control, lifts, access control, and BMS complete
activities.procedure_required: Systematic activation of every detector/manual call point scenario demonstrating the full cause-and-effect matrix responses, witnessed and recorded cell by cell
activities.safety_hold_point: Lift homing/recall verified before any lift remains in service during tests; occupants excluded from test floors
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% matrix cells demonstrated and witnessed by fire engineer and authority representative; deficiencies rectified and re-demonstrated

prerequisites: Pipework complete per floor and risers
activities.procedure_required: Hydrostatic test at 1.5x maximum working pressure (min 2-hour hold) floor by floor and on rising mains; fire pump churn, duty, and standby tests with curve recording
activities.safety_hold_point: Pressure relief verified before pressurisation; exclusion during pressurised hold at weak points
activities.acceptance_criteria: Zero pressure loss over hold period; pump curves meet design duty; certificates issued per zone

activities.procedure_required: Verify every input/output end-to-end from field device through controller to head-end graphics; test trends, alarms, and integration handshakes with fire, lifts, and metering
activities.safety_hold_point: No control writes to life-safety systems during testing without fire engineer approval
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% points verified correct; integration alarms tested; as-tested points list archived

activities.activity: Smoke control and stair pressurisation system test
prerequisites: Doors and pressure relief arrangements complete
activities.procedure_required: Performance testing of smoke extract and stair/lobby pressurisation per design scenarios: measure pressure differentials, airflow rates, and damper sequences floor by floor
activities.safety_hold_point: Floors under test evacuated of unrelated trades; fan test areas barricaded
activities.acceptance_criteria: Measured values within fire strategy tolerances for every scenario; report accepted by fire engineer

activities.procedure_required: Static and dynamic load tests at 125% rated load, travel over full track range, emergency lowering drill, and rescue procedure rehearsal
activities.safety_hold_point: Exclusion zone below cradle travel path during load testing; no personnel under suspended loads
activities.acceptance_criteria: Load tests pass without deformation or malfunction; rescue drill completed within target time; certification issued

activities.procedure_required: Bay-by-bay inspection of perimeter fire barriers and weather seals: continuity, compression, and support verification with photographic records per floor
activities.safety_hold_point: Work at perimeter only with edge protection and harness anchorages verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% perimeter bays inspected with no gaps in fire barrier continuity; photographic record appended to handover dossier

activities.procedure_required: Accompanied inspection by building control body covering structure, fire systems, accessibility, energy compliance evidence, and drainage; respond to observations
activities.safety_hold_point: Safe access provided to all inspection areas including roofs and plant; live systems flagged to inspectors
activities.acceptance_criteria: Completion certificate issued with no outstanding material contraventions

activities.procedure_required: Joint room-by-room and plant-room walkdowns recording snags with categories and owners; verify documentation, keys, access devices, and demo of systems to operators
activities.safety_hold_point: Live electrical and rotating plant access only with escorts and PPE per area rules
activities.acceptance_criteria: Practical completion declared; Category A snags zero; agreed minor items scheduled within defects liability period

activities.procedure_required: Full-rated duration discharge test of emergency lighting circuits across escape routes, stairs, and lift lobbies; verify illumination levels and changeover function
activities.safety_hold_point: Test conducted out of hours with temporary lighting arranged; areas with reduced lighting barricaded or escorted
activities.acceptance_criteria: All luminaires sustain rated duration at required illuminance; results logged per circuit in emergency lighting logbook

prerequisites: Seasonal conditions suitable or simulated loads arranged
activities.procedure_required: Performance commissioning of central plant: capacity tests, sequence-of-operation verification, stability tuning, metering validation, and part-load behaviour checks
activities.safety_hold_point: Rotating machinery guarding verified; refrigerant handling by certified technicians; isolation locks applied during intervention
activities.acceptance_criteria: Plant achieves design capacities and stable control sequences; performance report accepted; seasonal commissioning visits scheduled
